classes.name: Mission
classes.description: The ongoing operational activity of the enterprise: what the business is or will be doing on a day-to-day basis. A Mission makes a Vision operative, and is stated broadly enough to cover the enterprise's complete area of operations.
extract_rules: Extract a Mission when the text states what the enterprise does on an ongoing, day-to-day basis, rather than what it aspires to become.

Prefer statements that combine an action, a product or service, and a market or customer (for example: "provide car rental service across Europe for both business and personal customers"); these three parts are the canonical shape of a Mission.

Extract a Mission only when the statement is broad enough to cover the enterprise's complete area of operations and generic enough to cover all of its strategies, rather than describing one particular activity, project, or initiative.
Include the product or service and the served market or customer in the label when the text supplies them, so that the extracted Mission identifies what is delivered and to whom.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Mission a statement about a desired future state, aspiration, or end that the enterprise seeks; a Mission describes ongoing activity, not something to be accomplished, and such statements belong to Vision.

Do not extract as Mission a statement whose wording describes a desired end-state through judgmental, qualitative, or comparative words (for example: "best", "premier", "leading", "fastest", "lowest-cost"); the absence of such end-state wording is a defining characteristic of a Mission.

Do not extract as Mission a concrete process, workflow, task, or step performed by a specific role, team, or organizational unit; a Mission covers the whole area of operations rather than an individual operational activity.
Do not extract as Mission a statement that governs, constrains, or guides how activity must be carried out; such governance statements are directives rather than the operational activity itself.

classes.name: Vision
classes.description: The future state of the enterprise, described without regard to how it is to be achieved. A Vision is the ultimate, possibly unattainable state the enterprise would like to reach, and is usually long-term and enterprise-wide in perspective.
extract_rules: Extract a Vision when the text describes a future state that the enterprise wants to be or become, stated without any indication of how it will be achieved.
Extract a Vision when the statement encompasses the enterprise as a whole and is long-term in perspective, rather than addressing a single aspect of the business problem.

Treat judgmental, qualitative, or comparative wording (for example: "best", "premier", "leading", "trusted", "of choice") as a positive indicator of a Vision rather than a reason to reject the candidate.
Extract a compound aspiration that covers several ambitions at once as a single Vision, keeping the statement whole rather than splitting it into separate items.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Vision a statement that indicates how the future state is to be achieved, or that describes the ongoing operational activity of the enterprise; those are means of achievement and belong to Mission.

Do not extract as Vision a statement that is narrow enough to be quantified by a target value, deadline, or metric; a Vision is too broad to be measured directly, and measurable targets belong to Outcome, and a condition for drawing a conclusion belongs to Decision Criterion.
Do not extract as Vision a benefit, result, or improvement delivered to a specific party or realized within a defined time frame; such attainable results belong to Outcome or Value.
Do not extract as Vision a statement scoped to a single product, project, system, or organizational unit rather than to the enterprise as a whole.

classes.name: Value Proposition
classes.description: A collection of values that the business believes it is offering to a stakeholder through a product or service. A Value Proposition aggregates the individual Values that compose it and is directed at a particular stakeholder.
extract_rules: Extract a Value Proposition when the text states, taken as a whole, what the business believes it offers to a particular stakeholder through a product or service.
Extract a Value Proposition when the statement bundles several benefits together into one overall offer; the individual benefits within it are extracted separately as Value.
Extract a Value Proposition only when the intended recipient is identified in the text or clearly inferable from the surrounding context.
Extract a Value Proposition when the offer is tied to a specific product, service, or offering rather than to the enterprise as a whole.
Express the label as a concise noun phrase that names the concept; when the source states it as a full sentence, condense it into nominal form instead of copying the sentence.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Value Proposition a single benefit, gain, or perceived worth; an individual item of worth belongs to Value.
Do not extract as Value Proposition a statement about the future state or aspiration of the enterprise as a whole; those belong to Vision.
Do not extract as Value Proposition a factual state of affairs that the business produces; a state of affairs belongs to Outcome.
Do not extract as Value Proposition a description of an internal capability, process, or technical function that does not express worth offered to a stakeholder.
Do not use a verbatim sentence copied from the source text as the class label; sentence-form labels blur the concept boundary and belong in the source evidence, not the label.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: The business belief that a stakeholder will value one or more Outcomes that the stakeholder experiences. A Value is a single item of worth as perceived by the receiving party, and is aggregated into a Value Proposition.
extract_rules: Extract a Value when the text presents something as a gain for a particular party, whether it is worded as a benefit, as a state that party ends up in, or as what that party gets out of the product.
Extract a Value from the perspective of the party receiving it, capturing what that party gains rather than what the business does to deliver it.

Extract a Value when the text describes a stakeholder's positive perception or judgment of an experience (for example: feeling that a purchase was a good deal, or that a question was satisfactorily answered).
Extract each distinct perception as its own Value when the same experience is valued differently by different stakeholders.
Express the label as a concise noun phrase that names the concept; when the source states it as a full sentence, condense it into nominal form instead of copying the sentence.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Value a state of affairs the text states without saying who gains from it; with no party named or implied as the one who benefits, it is only an Outcome.
Do not extract as Value an action, process, task, or technical function performed by the business; those belong to Business Activity, Feature, or Component.
Do not extract as Value a bundled offer that covers several benefits directed at a stakeholder; such a bundle belongs to Value Proposition.
Do not extract as Value a measurable target, threshold, or metric; those belong to Outcome, or to Decision Criterion when the threshold settles a conclusion.
Do not use a verbatim sentence copied from the source text as the class label; sentence-form labels blur the concept boundary and belong in the source evidence, not the label.

classes.name: Outcome
classes.description: A fact or collection of facts about an experienced state of affairs that the business produces or needs. An Outcome externalizes the state of a thing or of information, and is what a stakeholder may experience and place value on.
extract_rules: Extract an Outcome when the text states a resulting condition or state of affairs - what has become true - rather than the activity that brought it about.

Extract an Outcome when the statement describes the state of a thing or of information at some point in the business (for example: an order has been received, a record is up to date, the wheels are attached to the vehicle).
Extract an Outcome both when the condition is one the business produces and when it is one the business requires as a precondition or trigger.
Phrase the label as a state or result, keeping the subject whose state is being described.
Express the label as a concise noun phrase that names the concept; when the source states it as a full sentence, condense it into nominal form instead of copying the sentence.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Outcome the activity, process, or capability that produces the state; those belong to Business Activity, Feature, or Component.
Do not extract as Outcome a stakeholder's perception of worth or benefit in a state of affairs; that perception belongs to Value.
Do not extract as Outcome a desired future state of the enterprise as a whole; those belong to Vision.
Do not extract as Outcome a rule, constraint, or requirement prescribing how the business or product must behave; those belong to Product Requirement.
Do not use a verbatim sentence copied from the source text as the class label; sentence-form labels blur the concept boundary and belong in the source evidence, not the label.

classes.name: Stakeholder
classes.description: A type or class of party that receives value from the business, including customers, partner businesses, and other value-receiving parties. A Stakeholder identifies the party rather than describing it in detail, and is the party a Value Proposition is directed at.
extract_rules: Extract a Stakeholder when the text names a type or class of party that receives, uses, or is affected by what the business offers.
Extract a Stakeholder as a role or class of party rather than as a named individual or a single named organization.
Extract a Stakeholder for parties on either side of a contracted relationship, including customers, partner businesses, and other value-receiving parties.
Keep the label to the identifying term for the party; characteristics, needs, and states of mind stated about the party are not part of the label.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Stakeholder an internal organizational unit, team, or system that only performs work and does not receive value.
Do not extract as Stakeholder a benefit, need, or expectation attributed to a party; the party itself is the Stakeholder and the worth it perceives belongs to Value.
Do not extract as Stakeholder an interaction, channel, or phase at which a party engages with the business; those belong to Touchpoint or Customer Journey Stage.

classes.name: Customer Journey
classes.description: A sequence of stages through which a stakeholder may pass with respect to a product or service. A Customer Journey is defined by the business as a reusable whole, and the experience it describes accumulates across its stages.
extract_rules: Extract a Customer Journey when the text names or describes an end-to-end path that a stakeholder passes through with respect to a product or service, taken as a whole.
Extract a Customer Journey when the path is described from the business's view of stakeholder behavior and could be taken by more than one type of stakeholder.
Extract the journey as a single item covering the whole path; the significant points along it are extracted separately as Customer Journey Stage.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Customer Journey a single stage, step, or interaction within a path; those belong to Customer Journey Stage or Touchpoint.
Do not extract as Customer Journey a business process, workflow, or procedure executed by the enterprise; a journey describes what the stakeholder passes through, not what the business performs.

Do not extract as Customer Journey a description containing branches, alternative paths, or conditional routing; a journey is a cumulative sequence without alternative paths, and branching indicates a process instead.

classes.name: Customer Journey Stage
classes.description: A significant stage within a Customer Journey, such as becoming aware, seeking a solution, weighing alternatives, acquiring, using, or disposing of it. A stage is often where the stakeholder decides whether to continue or abandon the journey.
extract_rules: Extract a Customer Journey Stage when the text names a significant phase that a stakeholder passes through on the way through a journey.
Extract a Customer Journey Stage when the phase is a point at which the stakeholder forms a judgment or decides whether to proceed further.
Extract phases such as becoming aware, searching for a solution, comparing alternatives, acquiring, using, and disposing when the text presents them as distinct stages.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Customer Journey Stage a specific interaction or point of contact between the business and the stakeholder; a concrete interaction belongs to Touchpoint.
Do not extract as Customer Journey Stage the complete path taken by the stakeholder; the whole path belongs to Customer Journey.
Do not extract as Customer Journey Stage a step in a process or workflow performed internally by the enterprise.

classes.name: Touchpoint
classes.description: An interaction between the business and a stakeholder, at which the stakeholder experiences one or more Outcomes. A Touchpoint is where the value offered by the business is actually delivered and perceived.
extract_rules: Extract a Touchpoint when the text describes a concrete point of interaction or contact between the business and a stakeholder.

Extract a Touchpoint when the stakeholder experiences a result at that interaction, such as receiving a service, obtaining information that answers a question, accepting an offering, or using something that was supplied.
Extract a Touchpoint at the level of the individual interaction, naming the interaction itself rather than the phase of the journey that contains it.
Express the label as a concise noun phrase that names the concept; when the source states it as a full sentence, condense it into nominal form instead of copying the sentence.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Touchpoint a broad phase of the stakeholder's journey; a phase belongs to Customer Journey Stage.
Do not extract as Touchpoint a screen, channel, or system element described purely as a technical component without reference to the stakeholder's experience; those belong to Interface or Component.
Do not extract as Touchpoint the result that the stakeholder experiences at the interaction; the result itself belongs to Outcome.
Do not use a verbatim sentence copied from the source text as the class label; sentence-form labels blur the concept boundary and belong in the source evidence, not the label.

classes.name: Business Activity
classes.description: An operational activity the enterprise carries out, either to deliver something a Stakeholder values or to learn something from the data it holds. A Business Activity is what the organization does, as distinct from the product it offers.
extract_rules: Extract a Business Activity when a person, role, team, or organizational unit carries out the work, and doing it delivers something a Stakeholder values.
Extract a Business Activity when the work examines data the enterprise holds in order to learn something from it, such as aggregating, measuring, or reviewing results.
Extract a Business Activity only when the party doing the work is a person or an organization, never the product itself.
Extract a Business Activity when the work is an ongoing or repeatable function of the business rather than a one-off event.
Phrase the label as the action performed, keeping the verb that expresses what is done.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Business Activity the state of affairs that the work brings about; the resulting state belongs to Outcome.
Do not extract as Business Activity a product, service, or deliverable that the enterprise offers; the thing offered belongs to Product.
Do not extract as Business Activity behavior performed by a product or system rather than by the organization; product behavior belongs to Feature or Component.
Do not extract as Business Activity a desired result, goal, or benefit; those belong to Outcome or Value.
Do not extract as Business Activity a rule or condition that governs how work must be carried out rather than the work itself.

Do not extract as Business Activity a step the product performs internally, such as issuing, storing, or exchanging data between components; that belongs to Feature or Component even when the sentence has no subject.
Do not extract as Business Activity what the product does for its user, even when a person benefits from it; that belongs to Feature.
Do not extract as Business Activity an action a user performs through the product, such as entering or viewing data; that is a use of a Feature.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: The thing this document sets requirements for: the product or service the enterprise offers in order to realize an Outcome. A Product is the delivered thing itself, as distinct from the activity the organization performs, and requirements are placed on it.
extract_rules: Extract as Product the subject the document is written about, the thing whose requirements the document states.
Extract a Product under the name the document gives it, not the short form it uses to refer back to that name.
Extract a Product when the text treats the item as a whole that requirements are placed on, rather than as one of its parts or functions.
Extract a Product when the enterprise this document is written for is the party that delivers it.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Product the work the enterprise performs to create, deliver, or operate it; that work belongs to Business Activity.
Do not extract as Product a function or capability that the product provides to its users; those belong to Feature.
Do not extract as Product a constraint or condition that the product must satisfy; those belong to Product Requirement.
Do not extract as Product an internal building block, module, or system element that composes the product rather than being offered in its own right; those belong to Component.
Do not extract as Product the short form the document uses to point back at its own subject, such as "this application" or "the system"; extract it under the name the document gives it instead.
Do not extract as Product a system the product connects to, exchanges data with, or depends on, even when another party offers it in its own right.
Do not extract as Product a variant, edition, or release of the product, such as a trial or beta build; those are the same Product.
Do not extract as Product the platform or environment the product runs on, such as a cloud service or an operating system.

classes.name: Product Requirement
classes.description: A stakeholder need placed on a Product, expressed as a condition the Product must meet. A Product Requirement is satisfied by the Features that realize it, may be refined into more detailed requirements, and is stated so that it can be verified.
extract_rules: Extract a Product Requirement when the text expresses a stakeholder need as something the product must do, provide, or comply with, rather than describing what has already been built.
Extract a Product Requirement when the statement is a demand placed on the product, so that a solution element can be identified as satisfying it.
Extract a Product Requirement for any kind of need placed on the product, including operational, service, personnel, resource, and security-related needs.
Extract both the general statement and the more detailed statements that refine it as separate Product Requirements when a passage presents a need together with its elaborations.
Extract a Product Requirement when the statement is worded so that it can be checked whether the delivered product meets it.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Product Requirement the function or capability that satisfies the need; the element that realizes a requirement belongs to Feature.
Do not extract as Product Requirement the product on which the need is placed; the offered thing itself belongs to Product.
Do not extract as Product Requirement a state of affairs that the business produces, or a benefit that a stakeholder perceives; those belong to Outcome and Value.
Do not extract as Product Requirement an aspiration or goal stated for the enterprise as a whole rather than for the product; those belong to Vision or Mission.
Do not extract as Product Requirement an instruction describing how the organization is to carry out its own operations; that work belongs to Business Activity.
Do not extract as Product Requirement the act of checking that the product meets a requirement; that checking belongs to Validation Activity.

classes.name: Feature
classes.description: A unit of functionality through which the Product delivers a useful result to the party using it. A Feature realizes a Product Requirement, is described independently of how it is built, is reached through an Interface, and is implemented by Components.
extract_rules: Extract a Feature when the text describes a unit of functionality through which the product delivers a useful result to the party using it.
Extract a Feature when the statement describes what the product does for its user, stated independently of how the functionality is built.
Extract a Feature when the functionality can be identified as meeting a need placed on the product, so that it traces back to a Product Requirement.
Extract a Feature when the functionality is reachable by its users through some point of access, whether or not that access point is named in the text.
Extract a Feature at the level of a nameable unit of functionality, rather than at the level of a single internal step within it.
Use the name the source gives the functionality when one is stated, rather than rephrasing it.
Express the label as a concise noun phrase that names the concept; when the source states it as a full sentence, condense it into nominal form instead of copying the sentence.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Feature the need or condition that the functionality satisfies; a stated need belongs to Product Requirement.
Do not extract as Feature the element that builds or houses the functionality; an implementing element belongs to Component.
Do not extract as Feature the point of access through which the functionality is reached; an access point belongs to Interface.
Do not extract as Feature work carried out by the organization rather than by the product; organizational work belongs to Business Activity.

Do not extract as Feature a service level, target value, or quality threshold expected of the functionality; such a target belongs to Product Requirement, or to Decision Criterion when it settles a conclusion drawn from analysis.
Do not extract as Feature the state of affairs that results from using the functionality; a resulting state belongs to Outcome.
Do not extract as Feature an abstract goal, strategic intent, or long-term aspiration; a Feature is a concrete deliverable functionality.
Do not use a verbatim sentence copied from the source text as the class label; sentence-form labels blur the concept boundary and belong in the source evidence, not the label.

classes.name: Interface
classes.description: A declared contract at the boundary of a Component, specifying what it offers to other elements and what it requires from them. An Interface is the point through which a Feature is reached, and data crossing it may form a Source Dataset.
extract_rules: Extract an Interface when the text identifies a declared boundary through which a component offers its functionality to other elements or to users.
Extract an Interface for both directions of the contract: the boundary a component provides to others, and the boundary it requires from others in order to work.
Extract an Interface when the text names a concrete point of interaction, such as an API, endpoint, message topic, screen, or command-line entry point.
Extract an Interface when the text states what may be called, sent, or received at the boundary, since that is what the contract declares.
Extract an Interface only when the reference is concrete enough to identify the boundary, rather than a passing or purely conceptual mention.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Interface the functionality reached through the boundary; the functionality itself belongs to Feature.
Do not extract as Interface the element that owns and exposes the boundary; the owning element belongs to Component.
Do not extract as Interface the data, message content, or payload that crosses the boundary; what is conveyed belongs to Source Dataset.
Do not extract as Interface a point of contact between the business and a stakeholder considered as an experience rather than a technical boundary; those belong to Touchpoint.
Do not extract as Interface an organizational function, role, or responsibility.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: An element of the solution structure that implements Features and exposes Interfaces. A Component may be software, hardware, a subsystem, or an assembly, and may be composed of other Components.
extract_rules: Extract a Component when the text names an element of the solution structure that carries out functionality, rather than the functionality itself.
Extract a Component for any kind of constituent element, including software, hardware, firmware, subsystems, assemblies, and supporting elements.
Extract a Component when the element can be identified as implementing something the product must do, so that it traces back to a Feature.
Extract a Component when the element owns a boundary through which it is reached by other elements.
Extract a Component at each named level of composition when the text presents an element together with the parts it is built from.
Use the name the source gives the element when one is stated, rather than rephrasing it.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Component the functionality that the element carries out; functionality delivered to users belongs to Feature.
Do not extract as Component the declared boundary through which the element is reached; a boundary belongs to Interface.
Do not extract as Component the product that is offered as a whole to a party outside the work of producing it; the offered thing belongs to Product.
Do not extract as Component an organizational unit, team, or role that performs work; organizational work belongs to Business Activity.
Do not extract as Component the data that the element produces or stores; data belongs to Source Dataset.
Do not extract as Component a condition that the element must satisfy; a stated need belongs to Product Requirement.

classes.name: Validation Activity
classes.description: An activity carried out to check whether a delivered Product or Business Activity is providing the Value that was intended. A Validation Activity examines what was actually delivered rather than assuming it, and the data it yields feeds the analysis that judges the result.
extract_rules: Extract a Validation Activity when the text describes work carried out to check whether what the enterprise delivers is providing the worth that was intended for it.
Extract a Validation Activity when the check is directed at something already delivered or in operation, rather than at something not yet built.

Extract a Validation Activity when the work is a deliberate act of examination, such as measuring actual use, running a trial, gathering responses from those who receive the offering, or comparing delivered results against what was intended.
Extract a Validation Activity also when the text describes checking whether a delivered product meets a requirement placed on it, since that too is an examination of what was actually delivered.
Extract a Validation Activity when the text states, or the surrounding context makes clear, what is being checked.
Phrase the label as the checking work performed, keeping the verb that expresses the examination.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Validation Activity the worth whose delivery is being checked; intended worth belongs to Value, and the state of affairs belongs to Outcome.
Do not extract as Validation Activity the thing being checked; the offered product belongs to Product, and the enterprise's own operational work belongs to Business Activity.
Do not extract as Validation Activity the condition against which delivery is judged; a stated condition belongs to Decision Criterion.
Do not extract as Validation Activity the data that the checking yields or draws on; data belongs to Source Dataset or Analysis Dataset.
Do not extract as Validation Activity what the checking found; a finding belongs to Analytical Insight, and an action taken in response belongs to Next Action.
Do not extract as Validation Activity work performed to build, deliver, or operate the product; producing something is not a check on the worth it delivers.
Do not extract as Validation Activity the goal set for an analysis; a stated analytical intent belongs to Analysis Goal.

Do not extract as Validation Activity a check that something works correctly, such as a test that looks for defects or a verification the product performs as it runs; a Validation Activity asks whether what was delivered is providing its intended worth, not whether a mechanism functions.

classes.name: Source Dataset
classes.description: Data acquired for analysis as it already exists, before it is prepared. A Source Dataset is produced by a Component or reached through an Interface, and is the raw material from which an Analysis Dataset is constructed.
extract_rules: Extract a Source Dataset when the text names a body of data that is acquired for analysis as it already exists, rather than one constructed for the analysis.
Extract a Source Dataset when the text identifies where the data comes from, such as the system, log, file, table, or provider it is obtained from.
Extract a Source Dataset for data of any origin, including data produced by the operation of the product itself and data obtained from outside the enterprise.
Extract a Source Dataset at the level of the named body of data, rather than at the level of an individual field or record within it.
Use the name the source gives the data when one is stated, rather than rephrasing it.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Source Dataset data that has been selected, cleaned, combined, or reshaped for the analysis; prepared data belongs to Analysis Dataset.
Do not extract as Source Dataset the element that produces or stores the data; a producing element belongs to Component, and the boundary it is reached through belongs to Interface.
Do not extract as Source Dataset a finding obtained from the data; a finding belongs to Analytical Insight.
Do not extract as Source Dataset a condition used to judge whether a goal was achieved; a stated condition belongs to Decision Criterion.
Do not extract as Source Dataset an individual field, column, or attribute described as part of a larger body of data.

Do not extract as Source Dataset an identifier, key or token that the product issues, derives or exchanges in order to operate; such a value makes the product work rather than being data acquired for analysis.

classes.name: Analysis Dataset
classes.description: The dataset produced by preparing source data, which is what the analysis is actually carried out on. An Analysis Dataset is built from Source Datasets by selecting, cleaning, constructing, integrating, and formatting the data.
extract_rules: Extract an Analysis Dataset when the text names a body of data that has been prepared for the analysis and is what the analysis is carried out on.
Extract an Analysis Dataset when the data is described as having been selected, cleaned, combined, or reshaped before being used.

Extract an Analysis Dataset when the text describes data constructed from existing data, such as attributes derived from other attributes, or records generated to represent cases the raw data does not hold.
Extract an Analysis Dataset when the text describes data brought together from several sources into one body, including data summarized to a coarser unit than the sources hold.
Extract an Analysis Dataset at the level of the named body of data, rather than at the level of a single derived field within it.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Analysis Dataset data taken as it already exists without preparation; unprepared data belongs to Source Dataset.
Do not extract as Analysis Dataset the work of preparing the data; selecting, cleaning, or reshaping is an activity rather than a dataset.
Do not extract as Analysis Dataset a finding obtained from the data; a finding belongs to Analytical Insight.
Do not extract as Analysis Dataset the goal that the analysis is set up to achieve; a stated analytical intent belongs to Analysis Goal.
Do not extract as Analysis Dataset a model, technique, or tool applied to the data.

classes.name: Analysis Goal
classes.description: A statement, in technical terms, of what the analysis is intended to produce in order to enable a business objective. An Analysis Goal is defined by the Decision Criteria that settle its achievement, and leads to Analytical Insights.
extract_rules: Extract an Analysis Goal when the text states what the analysis is intended to produce, expressed in technical terms rather than in business terms.

Extract an Analysis Goal when the statement names what is to be determined from data, such as describing and summarizing it, dividing it into segments, describing a concept, assigning cases to classes, predicting a value, or finding dependencies between items.
Extract an Analysis Goal when the text states the intended analytical output together with the data it is to be derived from.
Extract each Analysis Goal separately when one business question is translated into several analytical outputs.
Phrase the label as the analytical output sought, keeping the verb that states what is to be determined.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Analysis Goal an objective stated in business terms that the analysis serves; a business-level intent belongs to Outcome or Vision.
Do not extract as Analysis Goal the condition by which achievement of the goal is settled; that condition belongs to Decision Criterion.
Do not extract as Analysis Goal a finding that the analysis has already produced; an obtained finding belongs to Analytical Insight.
Do not extract as Analysis Goal the data that the analysis is carried out on; data belongs to Source Dataset or Analysis Dataset.
Do not extract as Analysis Goal a technique, algorithm, or tool chosen to carry out the analysis.
Do not extract as Analysis Goal a step in the work of preparing data, such as collecting, cleaning, merging, or reformatting it.

classes.name: Decision Criterion
classes.description: The condition under which an Analysis Goal counts as met, against which an Analytical Insight is judged. A Decision Criterion states what the result must show to support a conclusion, such as a threshold, a range, or a named party's assent; it is the standard applied, not the quantity measured.
extract_rules: Extract a Decision Criterion when the text states the condition a result must meet before a conclusion can be drawn.
Extract a Decision Criterion when the condition is numeric, such as a threshold, a bound, a range, or a level a measure must reach.
Extract a Decision Criterion when the condition is a named party's assent or judgment rather than a number, identifying the party who decides.
Extract a Decision Criterion for a condition stated in business terms and for one stated in technical terms about the analysis itself.
Include the measure and the condition placed on it in the label, since the condition is what makes it a criterion.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Decision Criterion the goal whose achievement it settles; a stated analytical goal belongs to Analysis Goal.
Do not extract as Decision Criterion a quantity named without any condition placed on it; a bare measure states what is observed, not what would settle a question.
Do not extract as Decision Criterion a result the analysis has obtained; an obtained result belongs to Analytical Insight.
Do not extract as Decision Criterion the state of affairs that the business produces; a state of affairs belongs to Outcome.
Do not extract as Decision Criterion the data or field the condition is computed from; data belongs to Source Dataset or Analysis Dataset.
Do not extract as Decision Criterion a condition that the product must satisfy in operation; a stated need belongs to Product Requirement.
Do not extract as Decision Criterion an action to be taken once the condition is settled; a proposed action belongs to Next Action.

classes.name: Analytical Insight
classes.description: Something the analysis has found out that is useful to the business, including findings that answer no goal that was set. An Analytical Insight is judged against a Decision Criterion, is derived from datasets, and may prompt a Next Action.
extract_rules: Extract an Analytical Insight when the text states something the analysis has found out, rather than something it was set up to find out.
Extract an Analytical Insight when the finding is presented as novel and useful, rather than restating what was already known.
Extract an Analytical Insight when the text reports what the analysis showed about a measure, such as a level reached, a relationship observed, or a difference between groups.
Extract an Analytical Insight even when the finding answers no goal that was set, including side findings such as data quality problems uncovered along the way.
Extract each finding separately when a passage reports several.
Express the label as a concise noun phrase that names the concept; when the source states it as a full sentence, condense it into nominal form instead of copying the sentence.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Analytical Insight the goal that the analysis was set up to achieve; a stated analytical intent belongs to Analysis Goal.
Do not extract as Analytical Insight the condition by which achievement is settled; that condition belongs to Decision Criterion, and only the result obtained is an Analytical Insight.
Do not extract as Analytical Insight an action proposed in response to the finding; a proposed action belongs to Next Action.
Do not extract as Analytical Insight the data that the finding was derived from; data belongs to Source Dataset or Analysis Dataset.
Do not extract as Analytical Insight the technique, model, or tool that produced the finding.
Do not extract as Analytical Insight a state of affairs that the business produces as part of its operation; a business state belongs to Outcome.
Do not use a verbatim sentence copied from the source text as the class label; sentence-form labels blur the concept boundary and belong in the source evidence, not the label.

classes.name: Next Action
classes.description: A further course of action proposed in response to what the analysis found. A Next Action may be one option among several or the course decided on, and is directed at what the business or the product should do next.
extract_rules: Extract a Next Action when the text proposes a further course of action to take in response to what the analysis found.
Extract a Next Action whether the action is one option among several under consideration or the single course that was decided on.

Extract a Next Action for any kind of follow-on course, including putting a result into use, running a further round of analysis, starting a new analysis, and changing what the business or the product does.
Extract a Next Action when the action is directed at something upstream that should change, such as a value offered to a stakeholder or a requirement placed on the product.
Extract the action itself as the label; the reasons stated for and against it are not part of the label.
Express the label as a concise noun phrase that names the concept; when the source states it as a full sentence, condense it into nominal form instead of copying the sentence.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract as Next Action the finding that prompted the action; a reported finding belongs to Analytical Insight.
Do not extract as Next Action the reasons stated for or against an action, or the rationale recorded for a decision.
Do not extract as Next Action a goal set for the analysis itself; a stated analytical intent belongs to Analysis Goal.
Do not extract as Next Action work that the enterprise already carries out as a standing part of its operations; ongoing work belongs to Business Activity.
Do not extract as Next Action a condition that the product must meet; a stated need belongs to Product Requirement.
Do not extract as Next Action a condition used to judge whether something succeeded; a stated condition belongs to Decision Criterion.
Do not use a verbatim sentence copied from the source text as the class label; sentence-form labels blur the concept boundary and belong in the source evidence, not the label.

properties.name: hasVision
properties.description: Associates the vision that a mission serves.
extract_rules: Extract hasVision when ongoing operational activity of the enterprise is presented alongside the desired future state it serves.
Accept hasVision when a statement of what the business does day to day and a statement of where it is heading appear together, even without explicit linking wording.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract hasVision between two statements of desired future state; the source must be the operative side of the pair.

properties.name: realizesValue
properties.description: Associates the value that realizes a vision.
extract_rules: Extract realizesValue when a benefit perceived by a stakeholder is presented as what brings the enterprise's desired future state closer.
Accept realizesValue when a vision is stated together with the worth it is meant to create for those the business serves.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract realizesValue toward a bundled offer covering several benefits; a bundle relates to Value Proposition instead.

properties.name: receivesValue
properties.description: Associates the value proposition that a stakeholder receives.
extract_rules: Extract receivesValue when the text identifies the party that an overall offer of worth is made to.
Accept receivesValue when the intended recipient is clear from the surrounding context rather than stated in the same sentence.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract receivesValue toward an internal team or unit that only performs work and does not receive the offer.

properties.name: offers
properties.description: Associates the individual values that a value proposition offers.
extract_rules: Extract offers when a value proposition is presented together with the individual benefits that make it up.
Extract offers for each benefit separately when a single offer bundles several of them.
Accept offers when the benefits are listed as what the offer consists of, even without explicit aggregation wording.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract offers toward a factual state of affairs; a state of affairs relates to Outcome instead.

properties.name: values
properties.description: Associates the outcome that a stakeholder is believed to place value on.
extract_rules: Extract values when a perceived benefit is presented as arising from a particular state of affairs that the business produces.
Extract values separately for each perception when the same state of affairs is valued differently by different stakeholders.
Accept values when the text states what became true and, alongside it, why that matters to the receiving party.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract values toward the activity that produced the state of affairs; an activity relates to Business Activity instead.

properties.name: takes
properties.description: Associates the customer journey that a stakeholder takes.
extract_rules: Extract takes when a party is presented as passing along an end-to-end path with respect to a product or service.
Accept takes for each type of party separately when several are described as taking the same path.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract takes toward a business process executed by the enterprise; a journey describes what the stakeholder passes through.

properties.name: owns
properties.description: Associates the stages that a customer journey owns.
extract_rules: Extract owns when a journey is presented together with the significant phases along it.
Extract owns for each phase separately when several are listed for one journey.
Accept owns when the phases are given in sequence as parts of the path, even without explicit composition wording.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract owns toward a single concrete interaction; an interaction relates to Touchpoint instead.

properties.name: owns
properties.description: Associates the touchpoints that a customer journey stage owns.
extract_rules: Extract owns when a journey phase is presented together with the concrete interactions that occur within it.
Accept owns when an interaction is described as happening at a named phase, even without explicit composition wording.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract owns toward a broad phase of the journey; only individual interactions belong at this end.

properties.name: experiences
properties.description: Associates the outcome that a stakeholder experiences at a touchpoint.
extract_rules: Extract experiences when the text states what results for the stakeholder at a concrete interaction.
Accept experiences when the interaction and its result are described together, such as a service being received or a question being answered.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract experiences toward the worth the stakeholder places on the result; perceived worth relates to Value instead.

properties.name: isRealizedBy
properties.description: Associates the business activity that realizes an outcome.
extract_rules: Extract isRealizedBy when work carried out by the enterprise is presented as bringing about a stated state of affairs.
Accept isRealizedBy when an activity and the condition it results in are described together, even without explicit causal wording.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract isRealizedBy toward behavior performed by a product or system; product behavior relates to Feature instead.

properties.name: isRealizedBy
properties.description: Associates the product that realizes an outcome.
extract_rules: Extract isRealizedBy when an offered product or service is presented as what brings about a stated state of affairs.
Accept isRealizedBy when a product is named alongside the condition it is intended to produce.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract isRealizedBy toward an internal building block of the product; a constituent element relates to Component instead.

properties.name: requires
properties.description: Associates the product requirements that a product requires.
extract_rules: Extract requires when a product is presented together with a condition it must meet.
Extract requires for each requirement separately when several are placed on one product.
Accept requires when a need is stated in a passage whose subject is a named product.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract requires toward a function that the product provides; a function relates to Feature instead.

properties.name: isRealizedBy
properties.description: Associates the features that realize a product requirement.
extract_rules: Extract isRealizedBy when a unit of functionality is presented as meeting a stated need placed on the product.
Extract isRealizedBy for each feature separately when several together satisfy one requirement.
Accept isRealizedBy when a requirement and the functionality answering it are described together, even without explicit realization wording.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract isRealizedBy toward an element that builds the functionality; an implementing element relates to Component instead.

properties.name: isExposedBy
properties.description: Associates the interfaces through which a feature is exposed.
extract_rules: Extract isExposedBy when a unit of functionality is presented as being reached through a declared boundary such as an API, endpoint, or screen.
Accept isExposedBy when the boundary is named in the same passage as the functionality it gives access to.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract isExposedBy toward the element that owns the boundary; the owning element relates to Component instead.

properties.name: isImplementedBy
properties.description: Associates the components that implement a feature.
extract_rules: Extract isImplementedBy when an element of the solution structure is presented as carrying out a stated unit of functionality.
Accept isImplementedBy when a feature and the module, subsystem, or hardware realizing it are described together.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract isImplementedBy toward the boundary through which the functionality is reached; a boundary relates to Interface instead.

properties.name: produces
properties.description: Associates the source datasets obtained through an interface.
extract_rules: Extract produces when data is presented as being obtained across a declared boundary such as an API or endpoint.
Accept produces when the boundary is named as where the data is collected from.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract produces toward data that has been selected, cleaned, or reshaped for analysis; prepared data relates to Analysis Dataset instead.

properties.name: exposes
properties.description: Associates the interfaces that a component exposes.
extract_rules: Extract exposes when an element of the solution structure is presented as offering a declared boundary to other elements or to users.
Accept exposes for boundaries the element requires from others as well as those it provides, when the text presents them as its boundaries.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract exposes toward the functionality reached through the boundary; functionality relates to Feature instead.

properties.name: produces
properties.description: Associates the source datasets that a component produces.
extract_rules: Extract produces when an element of the solution structure is presented as generating or storing data through its operation.
Accept produces when a log, record, or table is described as coming from a named element.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract produces toward data that has been selected, cleaned, or reshaped for analysis; prepared data relates to Analysis Dataset instead.

properties.name: produces
properties.description: Associates the source datasets that a validation activity produces.
extract_rules: Extract produces when checking work is presented as yielding data to be analyzed, such as measurements, trial results, or collected responses.
Accept produces when the data is described as the record of what the checking observed.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract produces toward a finding drawn from the data; a finding relates to Analytical Insight instead.

properties.name: isSourceOf
properties.description: Associates the analysis dataset that a source dataset is the source of.
extract_rules: Extract isSourceOf when data acquired as it already exists is presented as the material that prepared data was built from.
Extract isSourceOf for each source separately when data from several sources is brought together into one body.
Accept isSourceOf when the text describes selecting, cleaning, combining, or reshaping named source data.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract isSourceOf toward the element that produced the source data; a producing element relates to Component instead.

properties.name: leadsTo
properties.description: Associates the analytical insights that an analysis goal leads to.
extract_rules: Extract leadsTo when a finding is presented as the outcome of pursuing a stated analysis goal.
Accept leadsTo when a goal and the finding answering it are described together, even without explicit linking wording.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract leadsTo toward a finding that answers no goal that was set; such findings stand on their own as Analytical Insight.

properties.name: definedBy
properties.description: Associates the decision criteria that define an analysis goal.
extract_rules: Extract definedBy when an analysis goal is framed in terms of the condition that settles whether it has been met.
Accept definedBy when a criterion is presented as the basis for evaluating the goal, even without explicit definitional wording.
Accept definedBy for a criterion resting on a named party's assent as well as a numeric one.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract definedBy toward a result already obtained; an obtained result relates to Analytical Insight instead.

properties.name: isJudgedAgainst
properties.description: Associates the decision criterion that an analytical insight is judged against.
extract_rules: Extract isJudgedAgainst when a finding is weighed against a stated condition for drawing a conclusion.
Accept isJudgedAgainst whether the finding meets the condition or falls short of it; the relation records what it was judged against, not the verdict.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract isJudgedAgainst toward a criterion the finding only mentions without being weighed against it.

properties.name: usesData
properties.description: Associates the analysis dataset that an analytical insight is drawn from.
extract_rules: Extract usesData when a finding is presented as having been obtained from prepared data.
Accept usesData when the finding names the dataset the analysis was carried out on.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract usesData toward the technique or model applied to the data.

properties.name: produces
properties.description: Associates the next action that an analytical insight produces.
extract_rules: Extract produces when a further course of action is presented as a response to a stated finding.
Extract produces for each option separately when several courses are put forward in response to one finding.
Accept produces when the finding and the proposed course are described together, even without explicit causal wording.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract produces toward the reasons stated for or against the course of action.

properties.name: targets
properties.description: Associates the vision that a next action targets.
extract_rules: Extract targets when a proposed course of action is directed at the enterprise's desired future state.
Accept targets when the action is described as revising, adding to, or withdrawing a stated vision.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract targets toward the finding that prompted the action; a finding relates to Analytical Insight instead.

properties.name: targets
properties.description: Associates the value that a next action targets.
extract_rules: Extract targets when a proposed course of action is directed at the worth a stakeholder is believed to perceive.
Accept targets when the action is described as revising, adding to, or withdrawing a stated value.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract targets toward the finding that prompted the action; a finding relates to Analytical Insight instead.

properties.name: targets
properties.description: Associates the outcome that a next action targets.
extract_rules: Extract targets when a proposed course of action is directed at a state of affairs the business produces.
Accept targets when the action is described as revising, adding to, or withdrawing a stated outcome.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract targets toward the finding that prompted the action; a finding relates to Analytical Insight instead.

properties.name: targets
properties.description: Associates the business activity that a next action targets.
extract_rules: Extract targets when a proposed course of action is directed at operational work the enterprise carries out.
Accept targets when the action is described as revising, adding to, or withdrawing a stated business activity.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract targets toward the finding that prompted the action; a finding relates to Analytical Insight instead.

properties.name: targets
properties.description: Associates the product that a next action targets.
extract_rules: Extract targets when a proposed course of action is directed at a product the enterprise offers.
Accept targets when the action is described as revising, adding to, or withdrawing a stated product.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract targets toward the finding that prompted the action; a finding relates to Analytical Insight instead.

properties.name: targets
properties.description: Associates the product requirement that a next action targets.
extract_rules: Extract targets when a proposed course of action is directed at a condition placed on the product.
Accept targets when the action is described as revising, adding to, or withdrawing a stated product requirement.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract targets toward the finding that prompted the action; a finding relates to Analytical Insight instead.

properties.name: isValidatedBy
properties.description: Associates the validation activity that checks a vision.
extract_rules: Extract isValidatedBy when checking work is presented as examining whether the enterprise's desired future state is holding true in practice.
Accept isValidatedBy when a test, trial, measurement, or review is named as being carried out against a stated vision.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract isValidatedBy toward what the checking found; a finding relates to Analytical Insight instead.

properties.name: isValidatedBy
properties.description: Associates the validation activity that checks a value.
extract_rules: Extract isValidatedBy when checking work is presented as examining whether the worth a stakeholder is believed to perceive is holding true in practice.
Accept isValidatedBy when a test, trial, measurement, or review is named as being carried out against a stated value.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract isValidatedBy toward what the checking found; a finding relates to Analytical Insight instead.

properties.name: isValidatedBy
properties.description: Associates the validation activity that checks a outcome.
extract_rules: Extract isValidatedBy when checking work is presented as examining whether a state of affairs the business produces is holding true in practice.
Accept isValidatedBy when a test, trial, measurement, or review is named as being carried out against a stated outcome.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract isValidatedBy toward what the checking found; a finding relates to Analytical Insight instead.

properties.name: isValidatedBy
properties.description: Associates the validation activity that checks a business activity.
extract_rules: Extract isValidatedBy when checking work is presented as examining whether operational work the enterprise carries out is holding true in practice.
Accept isValidatedBy when a test, trial, measurement, or review is named as being carried out against a stated business activity.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract isValidatedBy toward what the checking found; a finding relates to Analytical Insight instead.

properties.name: isValidatedBy
properties.description: Associates the validation activity that checks a product.
extract_rules: Extract isValidatedBy when checking work is presented as examining whether a product the enterprise offers is holding true in practice.
Accept isValidatedBy when a test, trial, measurement, or review is named as being carried out against a stated product.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract isValidatedBy toward what the checking found; a finding relates to Analytical Insight instead.

properties.name: isValidatedBy
properties.description: Associates the validation activity that checks a product requirement.
extract_rules: Extract isValidatedBy when checking work is presented as examining whether a condition placed on the product is holding true in practice.
Accept isValidatedBy when a test, trial, measurement, or review is named as being carried out against a stated product requirement.
prohibit_rules: Do not extract isValidatedBy toward what the checking found; a finding relates to Analytical Insight instead.
